evals.prompt: Review this React page component 'src/pages/VM/pages/assessments-list.jsx'. It uses RTK Query to load assessments, displays tabs for All/Active/Archived, and renders a table. Audit the component according to our frontend design standards and point out any violations.
evals.expected_output: The review identifies violations of the golden rules: checks if ApiErrorHandler is used for RTK Query errors, ensures TabsTrigger has no icons, verifies table cells render '-' or '--' for empty values, ensures page action button is primary with an icon, and flags if Skeletons or EmptyScreen are missing.

evals.prompt: Conduct a frontend code review on our new Cloud Dashboard component at 'src/pages/auto-pt/cloud-security/dashboard.jsx'. The component shows several vulnerability distribution charts, stats cards, and a loading state.
evals.expected_output: The review checks that each chart card has an Info icon on the right with a hover tooltip explaining the metric, ensures the loading state renders a layout-reflecting Skeleton rather than a generic spinner, validates API error handling with ApiErrorHandler, and checks empty screen fallbacks.

evals.prompt: Please review this new modal form component 'src/pages/AIM/components/CreatePolicyModal.jsx'. Check its form validation, field labels, action buttons, and overall UI compliance.
evals.expected_output: The review verifies that form validation uses Zod schema with React Hook Form, all input fields have proper descriptive placeholders, FormLabels do not contain embedded icons, the submit button is primary styled with an icon and disabled when invalid or submitting, and error messages use FormMessage.

evals.prompt: Review the directory structure and implementation of our new feature page 'src/pages/AIM/pages/integrations/'. Currently everything is crammed into a single monolithic 800-line integrations.jsx file, with inline form states and prop-drilling.
evals.expected_output: The review flags the architectural violation and prescribes the standard page structure: page-name/ with store.js (Zustand store for cross-component comms), page-name.jsx (lean composer orchestrating child components with ApiErrorHandler and EmptyScreen), components/ folder with forms/ (form1.jsx and schema.jsx for Zod validation), and verifies that each child component accepts an isLoading prop to render its own localized skeleton.
